en.title: House of the Dragon Star Fabien Frankel Delivers a Career-Defining Performance
en.summary: Fabien Frankel's portrayal of Ser Criston Cole reached a fever pitch in the latest House of the Dragon episode. His raw, emotional turn has earned him widespread acclaim and TVLine's Performer of the Week.
en.body:
The dragons may dominate the skies, but it was the human heart — or the shattered remnants of one — that truly commanded attention in the latest episode of **House of the Dragon**. **Fabien Frankel**, stepping into the complex role of Ser Criston Cole, delivered a performance so potent, so raw, it rightfully earned him TVLine's Performer of the Week.

Frankel’s Criston has been a character of simmering resentment and volatile swings since the series began, a knight torn between duty, desire, and a deep-seated sense of injustice. In this particular installment, however, the character’s internal turmoil erupted with devastating force. We saw a man pushed to his absolute breaking point, grappling with a profound death wish that was palpable in every scene. Frankel navigated these treacherous emotional waters with astonishing skill, portraying Criston not as a simple villain, but as a deeply wounded individual whose actions, however extreme, stemmed from a place of genuine pain and disillusionment. His ability to convey such profound despair and self-loathing, often through mere glances or a strained silence, is a testament to his talent and a significant reason why **House of the Dragon** continues to captivate its audience.

## A Knight's Descent

Ser Criston Cole’s journey has been one of the most compelling, and often frustrating, arcs in **House of the Dragon**. From his honorable beginnings as a celebrated warrior to his current state of emotional chaos, Frankel has been the anchor, grounding the character’s dramatic shifts in believable human emotion. The episode in question saw Criston at his lowest, a figure consumed by guilt and despair following the events of the previous season. His interactions, particularly those tinged with a desperate longing for an end to his suffering, were heart-wrenching. Frankel’s portrayal was not about grand pronouncements but about the quiet, devastating moments that reveal a soul in torment.

## Fan Reaction and Future Stakes

Fans have been deeply invested in Criston Cole’s fate, with many taking to social media to discuss Frankel's powerful portrayal. While some express frustration with Criston’s choices, there’s an undeniable respect for the complexity Frankel brings to the role. His performance elevates the character beyond a mere pawn in the game of thrones, making him a figure fans love to hate, or perhaps, to pity. The stakes for Criston’s character are immense; his continued presence, especially in his current state, poses a significant threat to the fragile peace and adds a layer of unpredictable danger to the unfolding civil war. Frankel’s ability to make such a morally ambiguous character so compelling is a crucial element in **House of the Dragon**’s success, ensuring viewers remain on the edge of their seats, wondering what Criston will do next.

## What's Next

As **House of the Dragon** continues its intense second season, the trajectory of Ser Criston Cole remains a critical point of interest. Viewers will be watching closely to see how Frankel’s character navigates the escalating conflict and whether he can find any semblance of redemption or succumbs entirely to his inner demons. New episodes are releasing weekly.

content_raw: Fabien Frankel was absolutely captivating as Ser Criston Cole revealed a death wish on House of The Dragon - see why he's TVLine's Performer of the Week.
